analysis.title: Last man standing collapsed
key_insights: On October 29 the desk warned that Taiwan was the last man standing in the global AI reversal and highlighted downside convexity via EWT puts. The market has since collapsed.
EWT closed below its 200-day moving average during yesterday's selloff, the first close below it since April 2025. The note flags a longer-term trendline now coming into play.
EWT is described as being as oversold as it has been on only a handful of occasions over the past decade. Taiwan had until recently looked immune to the global AI selloff.
The EWT/EWY performance gap has not fully closed, but Taiwan's catch-down versus Korea has been sharp.
The desk's EWT December 95 put, flagged in late October, has risen sharply. The desk prefers outright low-delta puts over spreads to maximize convexity, and recommends booking gains and moving on.

trade_ideas.description: Take profits on the long EWT December 95 put, initiated in late October (October 29 note)
trade_ideas.rationale: The put has risen sharply since the late-October call and EWT is now deeply oversold, so the desk says it is time to book gains and move on.

risk_factors: The last traded price of the EWT December 95 put was distorted by the wide closing bid/ask spread, so the charted value is theoretical.
